The question of whether the Temple of Solomon was real is subject to conflicting scholarly opinions and research outcomes. Some sources treat it as a historical fact, stating King Solomon built the first Temple in Jerusalem [d5], a narrative supported by ancient Muslim texts [d7]. However, other research challenges this, proposing the temple was actually located in Egypt and identifying Solomon with Pharaoh Amenhotep [d2]. Furthermore, archaeologists note that no physical remnants of Solomon's Temple have been found in Jerusalem [d6], while biblical accounts and later traditions continue to describe its construction and significance [d3, d1].
